call_points.text: Q3 fuel cost guided at ₹1.80/million kcal, up from ₹1.59 in Q2.
FY27 capex raised to ₹1,200 Cr; FY28 outlay seen at ₹800-900 Cr.
Industry demand growth expected at ~8% in H2FY27.
Total Q3 cost inflation expected at ₹100-120/t over Q2.
Surat plant utilization targeted at 50-60% in Q4FY27.
Premium product share hit historic high of 45%; trade mix at 75%.
Rake availability remains an important factor to monitor after coal supply prioritisation to power.
Kutch clinker unit and CPP are targeted for H2FY27; grinding unit and WHR for H1FY28.
2 MMTPA grinding capacity at Surat was commissioned in Q2FY27.
Government capex has headroom, with 77% of planned state outlays yet to be deployed in H2FY27.
Management targets net debt at 2-2.5x EBITDA and expects to meet it in FY27.
Vadraj clinker and grinding units planned for phased commissioning between Q3FY27 and Q1FY28.
A bulk cement terminal at Viramgam, Gujarat, with about 1.5 million tons per annum handling capacity, is targeted for FY28.
Management estimates total cost inflation of about ₹200/t in April, which price increases do not fully cover.
Rake availability fell from 4.5 to 4 per day in March as rakes were diverted to power plants, and remains a problem.
Management declined to give a mathematical reconciliation of price hikes versus cost increases.

timeline.summary: On its 15 April 2026 Q4FY26 call, Nuvoco reported record FY26 volume of 20.4 MT and EBITDA of ₹1,881 Cr, guided FY27 capex at ₹900 Cr and flagged about ₹200/t of cost inflation in April.
Nuvoco Vistas secured a rectification order dropping an ₹11.89 Cr income tax demand for FY23 on May 11, 2026.
Ind-Ra removed its 'Rating Watch with Developing Implications' on Nuvoco's bank loans and perpetual NCDs on June 2, 2026, assigning a Stable outlook and affirming IND AA/IND A1+ and IND AA- ratings.
Nuvoco Vistas Corporation Limited assigned Crisil AA/Stable rating for ₹500 Cr NCDs and reaffirmed existing debt ratings
Nuvoco Vistas reported Q1FY27 results with 5% YoY volume growth to 5.3 MT and 7% YoY EBITDA growth to ₹572 Cr.
On 2026-08-20, CRISIL reaffirmed A1+ rating on ₹1,100 Cr commercial paper programme after reducing limit by ₹600 Cr at company's request
On 2026-08-25, Nuvoco disclosed a ₹15.41 Cr CGST show cause notice against its subsidiary NU Vista for FY20-24 tax credits.
Nuvoco Vistas held its 27th AGM on August 31, 2026, approving all resolutions including appointment of Walker Chandiok & Co LLP as statutory auditors for five years.
Nuvoco Vistas executed definitive agreements to acquire 26% stake in Clean Max Ilgohp for a 46.4 MW wind-solar hybrid project in Rajasthan.
On 2026-09-28, Dy. Commissioner, State Tax (Audit), Patna issued a GST show cause notice of ₹10.70 Cr to NU Vista Limited for FY23, proposing denial of ITC and tax on advances.
On 2026-09-30, NU Vista Limited received a GST show cause notice of ₹24.99 Cr for FY22-23
On 2026-10-15, Nuvoco approved voluntary liquidation of subsidiary Algebra Endeavour Private Limited
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,789.97 Cr (+13.5% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹65.28 Cr.
Nuvoco's Q2FY27 investor presentation showed revenue of ₹2,790 Cr; EBITDA of ₹411 Cr (+11%) and 4.7 MMT volumes (+9%); with premium share at an all-time high of 45%.

Audio recording of Investor and Analyst Conference Call on Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 is available on company website, effective October 23, 2026.
Nuvoco Vistas raised its FY27 capex to ₹1,200 Cr and guided for ₹100-120/t cost inflation in Q3 due to rising fuel prices.
